column3: The True Little Sister Showdown : Siscalypse
Although God Eater is super interesting, I didn't call you all here today just to play multiplayer.
Oh, is that so? Then what is your reason for calling us here then? Please do explain.
Tadah!
The thing that Kirino triumphantly shows us is--
Ohoh, Kiririn-shi! "Siscaly", is it!
Yeah!
Siscaly -- Official title is Shin Imouto Taisen Siscalypse (The True Little Sister Showdown : Siscalypse)
Although it looks like an adventure game, it's actually a game where you train your "little sister", and pit her against others online.
And also, the girl who loses in battle will have their costume ripped up in a shameful way...
Kirino loves that game.
What about "Siscaly"? Do you want everyone to play against each other?
Ehehe, it's a little different...
See, see-
A 【Siscaly tournament】?
Yeah! It's a tournament to gather every player across the country with confidence in their skills and decide who is the strongest little sister user!
It's a tournament made just for me!
How could I possibly NOT participate in that?
We're here today to practice for this tournament!
If thou speak about that tournament, I also have some knowledge.
It is said that the winner will be awarded a prize from the organizers.
*gulp*
Mmf-hmm...
Kirino and Kuroneko... It appears they are both "very VERY interested" in the tournament prize.
While those two are usually on bad terms, this time it seems they share a common objective.
...Eh? The thing that just flashed by?!
?! And inside my head the "Siscaly Game Tournament" keyword is stuck and refuses to let go...
It's the same as with the "Two-Shot Conversation"; it feels like I'm playing a game.
I'm a third year high schooler, not a chuuni! Thanks to them, my peaceful ordinary life got corrupted by irrational eccentricity...
Okay, the exact name of this system will be: O.R.E. System. (Order.Record.Effect)
This being said...
The four of us will aim for victory at all costs.
So you can make a good proposal after all.
Kiririn-shi, Tis be a nice idea!
Ah... Impressive support...
The four of us will aim for victory at all costs...
Why do even I have to... Wait, hold on?!
There's something on the upper-left that's bothering me... Is that the ability of the O.R.E system?
With the almighty power to manipulate and control everything at hand... Is this the new power I was blessed with?
Oh well, I'll put these Chuuni delusions aside. If I want to join the tournament, I'll just have to select it.
Which means I'll have to take part in it too?!
Isn't that obvious? What are you saying?
That means if I perchance happen to win the tournament, I would get the rights to receive the 【tournament's prize】 as well?
Eh? You're also interested in the Siscaly goods?
Aha, I see. Did you also awaken to the "moe of little sisters"?
...Of course not.
You say something?
Nothing. Everyone joins the Siscaly tournament. That's a fun project.
Hehe, isn't it?
However...
Sorry, but I'll pass.
Huh? What are you saying?
You're all joining the tournament for the prizes, right?
Obviously.
But if a beginner like me were to participate, I'd be nothing more than a burden.
There's no need to purposefully reduce your chances of winning.
That won't be a problem if you undergo special training.
The opponents are gamers with lots of experience, right? I don't think that last minute training will somehow do it.
Even if I do get better at the game, I feel that it'd be rude to those who really like Siscaly.
...What do you mean?
Hmm... For example.
If someone, who doesn't like little sisters at all, were to quickly complete a really heart-wrecking little sister game and said it's a shitty game, how would
you feel?
See? That's how it is.
I'm not a Siscaly fan, and if I were to take part at the Siscaly tournament and win, it'd be rude to real Siscaly fans.
B-But...
Kiririn-shi, what Kyousuke-shi said is justified.
But, the tournament requires two people sets to take part... now we're one too many...
If that's the case, how about we get a member from the SNS?
Of course, I wouldst be happier if thou were to take part as well, Kyousuke-shi...
You are not coming?
...Yeah, I'm not.
Gnnnnnn...
...I get it. This guy isn't going to participate.
Sorry, Kirino. Even though you took the effort to invite me.
...Hmph.
No big deal. Besides, wouldn't it be easier with one less person in the special training?
I see. Kiririn-shi wanted to take part in the tournament together with Kyousuke-shi.
Huh? Don't be mistaken. No one said such a thing.
I see, I see? Being unable to play together with me makes you that sad!
Gross! Like hell it would!
Don't be shy!
Shut up! Everyone who's not taking part in the tournament, get out of the room immediately!
Yes, yes...
However...
With those three confined in the same room, I can't think it'll end without something bad happening.
Especially Kirino and Kuroneko. If it's about victory or defeat, any mistakes and they'll be out for each other's blood.
Well then, if we waste our time on quarreling, our chances of winning will decrease!
'Tis practice time! Our Siscaly training starts immediately!
Understood...
That's our Saori. She skillfully brought them together.
Leave your little sister to us; Senpai only needs to wait for news of victory.
You will forever regret not participating, but do look forward to hearing our exploits.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to them.
...If it's them, it'll be fine.
Saori, Kuroneko. Please take care of Kirino.
H-Hurry up and get out!
With my current skills, won't I just embarrass myself in front of others?
I don't mind losing, but they would become VERY devastated.
I don't want to bring them down by participating in the tournament, but there's no good reason to refuse...
